_comment: What rex-panes reads: every session on one Rex server, through the rex CLI, read-only.
_server_comment: Which Rex server to read: a host label from `rex hosts`, or an address. Empty means the CLI's own default - REX_SERVER when it is set, else this machine's server. CPU and memory are shown only for this machine's server.
_refresh_comment: Maximum idle delay in seconds; Rex events wake a full read sooner.
_agents_comment: Command names that count as coding agents. Matched against the pane's foreground program, and against the app name a program reports with OSC 7501 (claude also matches a report from claude-code or claude-cli).
